rationale: The Hallway Motion sensor was connected but not sending events, and the base station log showed "E-305 protocol v2 not supported" after the base station firmware update to 4.5 (which supports only v3). Firmware compatibility check confirmed the sensor was on protocol v2 with an OTA path to 1.4. The customer performed the OTA update, and motion alerts resumed, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Open the Hallway Motion device settings in the app
Start the available OTA firmware update to version 1.4
Keep the base station powered and online during the update
Confirm motion alerts resume after the update completes
output.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. The Hallway Motion sensor was using an older protocol (v2) that the updated base station no longer supports. The OTA firmware update to version 1.4 brought the sensor up to protocol v3, restoring motion alerts. Your system is now fully operational.
